body_markdown:
Hafnia was a participant at Pareto Securities’ 33rd Annual Energy Conference in Oslo, which is one of Europe’s largest gatherings of energy and shipping companies, institutional investors and analysts, hosted annually by Norwegian investment bank Pareto Securities.


Hafnia was represented by Søren Steenberg Jensen, CEO, Thomas Andersen, SVP Head of Investor Relations and Jacqueline Teng, Portfolio Manager, who held a series of one-to-one meetings with investors and analysts alongside the main conference program.


During the conference Søren presented Hafnia’s investor case to the wider audience before a moderated “get to know” session with August Klemp from Pareto.


The discussion covered his first weeks as CEO, how a career built in


commercial and


asset management shapes his read on current market risk and opportunity, and how Hafnia decides what belongs on its investment platform.


Following this segment, Søren joined Marius Lorentzen, TV editor and presenter at Norwegian financial daily Finansavisen, for a studio interview which covered his background, Hafnia’s strategy for 2026, the Strait of Hormuz, product tanker trade flows and tonne-mile development, and our fleet plans.


The interview was published on finansavisen.no and featured as part of the broader Børsmorgen program.
